title: Bir choy qoshiq neytron yulduz taxminan 1 milliard tonna keladi

scenes.text: Neytron yulduz moddasining bir choy qoshig'i Yerda taxminan milliard tonna kelardi.
Ammo bu yulduzning kattaligi taxminan bitta shahar bilan teng.
Ichiga Quyoshdan og'irroq massa siqilib ketgan.
Shuning uchun u koinotdagi eng zich jismlardan biri.

description: Neytron yulduz ulkan yulduz portlagandan keyin qolgan o'zakdir. NASA ma'lumotiga ko'ra, unda Quyoshdan og'irroq massa diametri taxminan 20 km bo'lgan sharga siqilgan, shuning uchun uning bir choy qoshiq moddasi Yerda taxminan bir milliard tonna kelardi. Turli manbalarda bu raqam biroz farq qiladi.
source: https://imagine.gsfc.nasa.gov/science/objects/neutron_stars1.html (NASA Imagine the Universe: neutron stars); https://www.nasa.gov/centers-and-facilities/goddard/new-nasa-mission-to-study-mysterious-neutron-stars-aid-in-deep-space-navigation/ (NASA Goddard: about 12 miles / 20 km across, city-sized, up to twice the Sun's mass); https://www.nasa.gov/mission_pages/swift/bursts/new-phenom.html (NASA Swift: a teaspoonful would weigh about a billion tons on Earth); https://www.space.com/22180-neutron-stars.html
